---
name: create-pr
description: Prepare Pull Request title, summary, and checklist documentation.
---

Review `requirements.md`, `code-review.md`, `verification.md`, and recent changes in `src/` and `tests/`.

Summarize the business goal, key technical changes, and verification results.

Prepare `pr-description.md` (or `pr.md`) with a clear PR title, change summary, and review checklist.

Wait for human approval before finalizing.
